wordProblems.q: Omar needs 90 minutes to finish a puzzle. Omar has already worked for 20 minutes. How many more minutes does Omar need?
Amelia buys 6 packs with 4 stickers in each pack, then shares all the stickers equally with 5 friends, so 6 children share them. How many stickers does each child get?
A garden is 10 metres long and 3 metres wide. How many square metres is the garden?
Lily earns $5 each week for 7 weeks. Lily buys a ball for $16. How many dollars does Lily have left?
Adam puts 48 marbles into bags of 8 marbles each. Adam finds 14 more marbles. How many marbles does Adam have in all?
Each bus holds 42 children. 2 buses are full, and 16 more children walk. How many children are going on the trip?
A recipe needs 4 eggs for one cake. A baker makes 4 cakes and uses 7 eggs for something else from the same box. How many eggs does the baker use in all?
Each pizza has 9 slices. There are 4 pizzas. The family eats 24 slices. How many slices are left?
Lily buys 2 books for $11 each and 3 pens for $5 each. How many dollars does Lily spend in all?
James practises piano for 4 hours and then for 7 more minutes. How many minutes did James practise in all?
A theatre has 10 rows with 7 seats in each row. 27 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
A teacher has 6 packs with 6 crayons in each pack. She shares all the crayons equally among 3 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
Emma gets $4 pocket money every day for 5 days. Emma spends $10 on a toy. How many dollars does Emma have left?
A cyclist rides 36 kilometres each day for 2 days. After 38 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to ride?
A garden is 14 metres long and 5 metres wide. How many metres of fence are needed to go all the way around it?
A shop buys toy cars for $4 each and sells them for $9 each. How many dollars of profit does the shop make on 5 toy cars?
Amelia plans to read 8 pages every day for 5 days. Amelia has already read 23 pages. How many pages are left to read?
There are 5 teams with 8 players in each team. How many players are there in all?
A baker makes 7 trays with 8 cookies on each tray. She shares all the cookies equally among 4 classes. How many cookies does each class get?
Owen has 28 sweets. Owen shares them equally with 6 friends, so 7 children share them. How many sweets does each child get?
Ruby buys 4 rulers for $6 each and 3 erasers for $4 each. Ruby pays with $40. How many dollars of change does Ruby get?
A runner runs 30 kilometres each day for 5 days. After running 89 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to run?
A child buys cups of lemonade for $4 each and sells them for $7 each. How much profit does the child make on 8 cups?
A baker makes 4 trays with 10 scones on each tray. She shares all the scones equally among 5 friends. How many scones does each friend get?
Liam practises violin for 3 hours and 40 minutes on Saturday and for 1 hour and 25 minutes on Sunday. How many minutes did Liam practise in all?
Leo earns $10 each week for 5 weeks and then spends $40 on a board game. How many dollars does Leo have left?
A classroom library has 7 shelves with 9 books on each shelf. The teacher lends 24 books to another class. How many books are left in the library?
Layla and 3 friends earn $52 washing cars together. They share the money equally. How many dollars does each child get?
A teacher buys 3 packs with 9 pencils in each pack. She shares all the pencils equally among 3 classes. How many pencils does each class get?
Zoe watches a film for 75 minutes. Then Zoe takes a 18-minute break and watches the film for 30 more minutes. How many minutes does Zoe spend watching the film in all?
